name: Otaru Rio
source:
Rio comes from Hokkaido. She was [url=/c10810]Shiina[/url]'s friend and classmate when they were in elementary school. She is currently hosting cosplay events in Akiba like [url=/c10820]Nobunaga[/url] does. 

Since Rio has moved to Tokyo, Shiina have not heard from her, but they reunite by chance when both of them are asked by [url=/c10817]Yuuto[/url] to participate in a cosplay event that Nobunaga organized.
